विराट कोहली और अनुष्का शर्मा मुंबई में अमेरिकी संगीतकार कृष्णा दास के लाइव कीर्तन में भक्ति संगीत में पूरी तरह डूबे नजर आए। 🎶
यह शानदार कॉन्सर्ट रविवार को हुआ, जिसके कई वीडियो और तस्वीरें सोशल मीडिया पर खूब वायरल हो रहे हैं।
वायरल वीडियो में अनुष्का ताली बजाती और भक्ति गीत गाती दिखीं, जबकि विराट भी कीर्तन में शामिल होते नजर आए। 🙏
यह जोड़ा नीम करोली बाबा की शिक्षाओं के प्रति गहरी श्रद्धा के लिए जाना जाता है और पहले भी ऐसे आध्यात्मिक कार्यक्रमों में शामिल हो चुका है।
फिलहाल यह कपल अपने दोनों बच्चों वामका कोहली और अकाय कोहली के साथ लंदन में रहता है और विराट न्यूजीलैंड के खिलाफ आगामी ODI सीरीज की तैयारी के लिए मुंबई में हैं। 🏏
क्या आपको भी ऐसे शांति भरे आध्यात्मिक संगीत सुनना पसंद है? नीचे कमेंट करके जरूर बताएं! 👇

ctx.title: Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma immerse themselves in devotional tunes at Krishna Das’ Mumbai concert
ctx.summary: Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma attended American musician Krishna Das' devotional kirtan concert in Mumbai.
ctx.text:
Virat Kohli and Anushka Sharma soaked in devotional music as American musician and vocalist Krishna Das performed live kirtan in Mumbai on Sunday. The couple were spotted attending Krishna Das’ kirtan evening and appeared fully immersed in the devotional tunes. Several videos and photos of the couple at the kirtan have been doing the rounds on social media.
In one of the videos, Anushka is seen clapping and singing along to the devotional chants, fully immersed in the spiritual evening. Virat, on the other hand, briefly glances at the camera before turning his attention back to the kirtan and joining in the devotional singing. The concert was part of Krishna Das’ India tour. Other videos show Virat and Anushka arriving at the Gateway of India before heading to the devotional evening.
A post shared by Team Innovation (@team.innovation)
This is not the first time Anushka and Virat have attended a Krishna Das kirtan. The couple also attended a service at Union Chapel in London in July 2026 and have often been spotted at similar spiritual events in India and abroad. Virat and Anushka are known for their reverence for the teachings associated with Neem Karoli Baba. They also regularly visit spiritual leader Premanand Maharaj in Vrindavan.
Neem Karoli Baba was recently in the news after Hanuman Ansh, a film based on his life, reportedly achieved significant box-office success. The film, which was made on a budget of approximately ₹ 1.5 crore to ₹ 2 crore, crossed ₹ 450 crore worldwide.
Krishna Das travelled to India in 1970 and became a close disciple and devotee of Neem Karoli Baba. He spent several years in India, primarily at Neem Karoli Baba’s ashrams, including Kainchi Dham in the mountains of Uttarakhand. Two of Krishna Das’ devotional chants, “Sita Ram” and “Om Namah Shivaya,” were also used in Hanuman Ansh.
Anushka and Virat have largely remained away from the public eye in recent years. The couple spend much of their time in London, UK, where they are raising their two children, Vamika Kohli and Akaay Kohli. They are currently in Mumbai as the cricketer prepares for India’s upcoming ODI series against New Zealand.
Meanwhile, Anushka has stayed away from the big screen. She was last seen in Shah Rukh Khan’s 2018 film Zero and later appeared in a cameo role in Qala. The actor has largely kept a low profile while focusing on her family and other commitments.
